answer.summary: Metrics export stopped due to a TimeoutError in the metrics collection callback at line 95 of measurement_consumer.py. The top suspect is commit 66a7c08f, which was previously deployed to FIX timeout issues in this exact file, suggesting a regression or incomplete fix. The failure impacts 14 dependent services and 25 files across the metrics export pipeline. Henry Chen (author of 66a7c08f) and the opentelemetry-sdk service owners should be paged immediately.
